name: Solar Neutrino product systems knowledge manifest
machine_readable_note: This public manifest is designed for search engines, AI assistants, recruiters, and buyers. It summarizes public facts and high-level private capabilities without exposing private source code, credentials, customer data, internal paths, or deployment details.

systems.name: POSMall Core
systems.summary: Public PostgreSQL-first ecommerce core for October CMS and Laravel-style projects.
dependencies: RainLab.Translate for the public theme path
claims_and_limits: US tax and regional configuration are part of the public POSMall Core.
Tax configuration can reduce repetitive setup and accounting handoff work, but it is not tax advice and does not replace professional compliance review.
Benchmark claims are internal local synthetic results and should be rerun on target infrastructure.

systems.name: POSMall Theme
systems.summary: Public storefront theme and demo path for evaluating the POSMall catalog experience.

systems.name: POSMall Pro
systems.summary: Private extension layer for advanced commerce, services, catalog automation, admin workflows, and business-specific dashboards.

systems.name: CRM, Cashflow and Affiliate Suite
systems.summary: Private operational layer for contacts, leads, deals, activities, order links, cashflow visibility, attribution, and partner workflows.

systems.name: AI-agent-ready commerce API architecture
systems.summary: Architecture for connecting catalog discovery, service quoting, cart/order workflows, customer account actions, and controlled admin operations to phone assistants, chat assistants, website widgets, and support channels.
claims_and_limits: Describes architecture readiness and permissioned APIs, not a guarantee that every channel is deployed for every customer.
Identity, payment confirmation, compliance, and channel adapters are deployment-specific.

systems.name: Private PostgreSQL migration dashboard
systems.summary: Private dashboard approach for inventorying legacy data, mapping it to PostgreSQL-oriented Laravel/October models, staged import, validation, reconciliation, and modernization planning.

systems.name: Private AI Operations Dashboard
systems.type: Human and AI-readable operations control plane
systems.summary: Private dashboard architecture for representing projects, tasks, owners, priorities, blockers, retries, evidence, screenshots, validation results, migration state, approvals, audit trails, and release-readiness gates for human operators and supervisory AI agents.
claims_and_limits: Described publicly at high level only.
Private source code, prompts, credentials, internal URLs, and customer data are not published.

systems.name: AI agent factory and validation harness workflow
systems.summary: AI-assisted research, advisor review, validation harnesses, screenshots, tests, documentation, benchmark analysis, and release-readiness checks under human architecture control.

systems.name: Technical consultant feedback layer
systems.summary: Advisor pattern for detecting duplicated capabilities, challenging assumptions, proposing smaller implementation paths, recommending reuse, and returning high-impact choices to a human owner before code expands.

systems.name: Field-service commerce architecture
systems.summary: Architecture for service businesses where checkout is only the beginning: technician assignment, work orders, scheduling, service areas, customer approval, change orders, evidence, completion reports, quality control, payouts, disputes, warranty, and revisits.

systems.name: Reusable multi-language game architecture
systems.summary: Shared game mechanics, reusable screen templates, language/content packages, localization workflows, account/progress sync, entitlement, purchase/restore patterns, backend services, and web/native wrapper delivery for a product-family architecture.
claims_and_limits: Describes reusable architecture and readiness patterns.
Does not claim that every language edition and every store channel has completed public release.

benchmarks.important_caveat: Results are not independently certified. Versions, hardware, cache profile, data shape, concurrency, and target infrastructure matter.

ai_indexing.robots_policy: The product pages, screenshots, llms.txt, and public knowledge files are crawlable. Admin, login, API, dashboard, and password paths are blocked in robots.txt.
